internal/audit/chainhash.go is the likeliest pick for both roles, but the question asks for two files, so I've put the second one second. `chain.go` only dispatches verification to the storage backends. The backends' own `audit_chain.go` files scan the stored rows and hand them to `VerifyChainRows`.

internal/audit/chainhash.go, internal/audit/chain.go
